lead: Vijaya Nirmala was an Indian film actor, born on 20 February 1944 in Madras Presidency.
She died on 27 June 2019 in Hyderabad at the age of 75.
She is associated with work such as Guinness World Records and has been recognised with Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award – South and Raghupathi Venkaiah Award.
The sections that follow break down Vijaya Nirmala's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
